text:
maria: Quick sync  we need a consolidated partner-facing plan for API/SDK v3 (auth header change + payload key rename input->prompt). Primary goals: avoid marketplace relisting failures, reduce SI churn, and surface telemetry for regressions. :megaphone:

sam: propose compressed timeline to balance speed vs partner ops:
- week 0: partner pre-notice email + migration FAQ
- week 2: publish SDKpatches (py/js/go) + migration scripts
- week 3: invite 3 partners to private canary (marketplace vendor + 2 OEMs/SIs)
- week 6: soft-deprecation (warning headers on v2)
- week 10: hard-deprecation

lee: marketplace vendors sometimes need extra lead due to review queues. we should bake a 3-week marketplace buffer into the partner deadline. also will draft a 1-paragraph addendum for Marketplace T&Cs.

ravi: telemetry ask  add a new metric tag `compat.v3_fail` and increment on v2->v3 mismatch. also tag by `partner_id` so we can surface a partner-level dashboard. can we add an automated alert when >0.5% of partner calls fail after migration?

anya: ops/support  recommend a dedicated support rota covering the private canary + 72 hours after soft-deprecation. volunteers? I'll coordinate with partner-success. :raising_hand:

sam: migration snippet for docs (will add to repo):
```
# v2 (old)
import requests
r = requests.post('https://api.redwood.ai/v2/generate', headers={'Authorization': 'Token rw-old'}, json={'input': 'hello'})
# v3 (new)
r = requests.post('https://api.redwood.ai/v3/generate', headers={'x-rw-key': 'rw-new', 'x-rw-version': '3'}, json={'prompt': 'hello'})
```

maria: good. also add a small compatibility shim we can offer partners who embed SDK binaries. shim idea: accept old `Authorization` header and rewrite to `x-rw-key` at ingress for a 6-month grace. legal needs to sign-off.

lee: noted. will include a liability clause for partners bundling our SDKs / runtime and a requirement for a signed compatibility attestation for binary bundlers.

deploy-bot: FYI marketplace deployments have a weekly blackout Sun 02:00-06:00 UTC and monthly marketplace maintenance windows on the 3rd Wed. schedule around them.

marketplace-bot: Vendor listing reviews can take up to 21 days depending on content changes. strongly advise partners to submit updated bundles at least 3 weeks before your target launch window.

ravi: release-engineering checklist suggestion:
- publish v3 SDKs and migration tool
- add `Deprecation` warning header on v2 responses
- add feature-flag gating for partner canaries
- enable telemetry and dashboard for partner failures
- perf-run for top 5 models on HW partners

anya: comms plan  two partner templates: marketplace vendors and SI/OEM integrators. include rollback steps, contact matrix, sample curl/python, marketplace submission steps, and expected review timelines. I'll draft both templates and post by Wed.

sam: perf note  switching kernels may change latency p50/p99. infra please run a perf delta for the top-3 models on our primary GPU types before we open canaries. @maria assign infra owner?

maria: assigning @ravi to coordinate infra perf runs. please include quantization levels in the matrix.

lee: legal will share T&Cs addendum + short FAQ by Fri.

sam: I'll open SDK PRs and a small `compat-shim` repo for partners who need a drop-in. aiming for PRs by Fri EOD.

maria: please each drop a one-line owner status in this thread by EOD Thu so I can assemble partner calendar and final notice. thanks. :thumbsup:
